title: Hynek and Vallee's Invisible College and its Rosicrucian namesake

tellings.quote: I think about the invisible College which was jlen heck's group with jacqu Valle which is a tongue and- cheek reference to Robert Bo's invisible College which was kind of at the start of the Enlightenment

plain: Michels says the Invisible College, an informal circle of scientists around the astronomer J. Allen Hynek and the researcher Jacques Vallée who quietly studied UFOs, took its name as a tongue-in-cheek nod to the Invisible College of the chemist Robert Boyle, a group at the start of the Enlightenment. He links that older circle to the Rosicrucians, a secretive mystical brotherhood of early modern Europe, through a book by the historian Frances Yates on the Rosicrucian roots of the Enlightenment, which he does not name. He raises it in a talk with the scholar Diana Pasulka, as a hint that the modern UFO researchers saw themselves in a long line of hidden scholarly brotherhoods.
